name: Buffet Daily Soup Kettle & Sourdough Bread Bowls (Lunch)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Each lunch features two rotating hot soups—often a smooth purée (butternut squash, potato leek, carrot ginger, or tomato) alongside chicken noodle or chowder.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the smooth puréed vegetable/potato soup or chicken noodle soup with a soft white roll; skip minestrone, lentil, or spicy gumbo rotations.
watchOuts: Dairy cream in bisques/chowders (take a Lactaid)
Check placards for chili or bean soups
